name: animated-gradient-text
title: Animated Gradient Text
blurb: Text fills with a gradient that drifts smoothly from left to right on loop.
description: Inline text element with a background gradient that animates horizontally. Gradient position cycles continuously. Supports custom Tailwind gradient stops and animation speed.
use_when: Inline text within a sentence needs a subtle animated gradient fill without full-width treatment.
avoid_when: When text must have a stable, predictable appearance for readability.
a11y: Text content is readable; gradient is a visual overlay using background-clip.
